onClick: {{ (async () => { try { const reason = inpCompanyDonorContactReason.text?.trim(); const id = selCompanyDonorContactToArchive.selectedOptionValue; if (!reason || !id) { showAlert('Select a contact and enter a reason.', 'warning'); return; } const entry = (qCompanyDonorContacts.data || []).find(c => c.contact_id === id); if (!entry) throw new Error('Refresh the profile and select the contact again.'); const result = await qArchiveCompanyDonorContact.run({ kind: entry.contact_kind, id, reason }); if (!result?.[0]?.archived) throw new Error('The contact was not archived.'); await Promise.all([qCompanyDonorContacts.run(), qCompanyContacts.run(), qCompanyProfile.run()]); showAlert('Contributor contact archived.', 'success'); } catch (e) { showAlert('Contact archive failed: ' + (e?.message || e), 'error'); } })() }}
